english.title: Use limiting device re Sch 4A premises to enforce payment due for water supply
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker, used a limiting device in relation to premises specified in Schedule 4A to the Water Act 1991, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), with the intention of enforcing payment of charges which were or may have become due in respect of the supply of water to the premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63A(1) and (4) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a water undertaker
used a limiting device in relation to any premises specified in Schedule 4A to the Water Act 1991
with the intention of enforcing payment of charges which were or may have become due to the undertaker in respect of the supply of water to the premises.
